title: RUNFT
tagline: Runft turns fitness runs into unique generative NFTs with marketplace trading.
description:
Runft is a Web3 fitness platform that transforms your running activities into unique, tradeable NFTs. By connecting your wallet and syncing with Strava or GPS data, every run you complete generates a one-of-a-kind digital artwork based on your route, timestamp, and performance metrics. The platform features a built-in marketplace where users can buy, sell, and showcase their Runfts, creating a new economy around fitness achievements. We've also integrated ETH Global's NFC technology to enable seamless tap-to-pay functionality, allowing users to purchase NFTs and marketplace items with simple NFC card taps, making Web3 transactions as easy as contactless payments. Each NFT serves as verifiable proof of your running history, combining the motivation of fitness tracking with the collectibility of digital assets. The platform bridges the gap between physical activity and digital ownership, making every mile meaningful in the Web3 ecosystem.

This integration makes the platform more accessible by removing the complexity of traditional crypto transactions, enabling mainstream adoption through familiar payment methods while maintaining the benefits of blockchain technology.
how_its_made: Runft is built with a modern tech stack combining React frontend with ShadCN UI components and Tailwind CSS for a responsive user experience. The smart contracts are deployed on Arbitrum Sepolia using Solidity, enabling low-cost NFT minting and marketplace transactions. The platform integrates with Strava API for importing run data and uses TomTom API for route visualization and mapping. The generative NFT system uses deterministic algorithms that combine timestamp, GPS coordinates, distance, and duration data to create unique visual representations of each run. MetaMask integration provides secure wallet connectivity, while the marketplace functionality allows seamless trading of fitness NFTs. The combination of fitness tracking, generative art, and blockchain technology creates a novel approach to gamifying exercise and building a community around athletic achievements.
